## Traceability

- [ ] Change maps to `docs/requirements-traceability.md`
- [ ] One domain implementation and one state model remain
- [ ] Public changes stay under `/api/v1`
- [ ] Mutations enforce idempotency and revision policy
- [ ] New execution evidence is immutable
- [ ] `corepack pnpm verify` passes
- [ ] App image has no Docker CLI or socket
- [ ] Logs, events, and results contain no credentials
- [ ] Cleanup commands target only named AIWS resources
